input.command:
EV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-evidence-XXXXXX) && git diff --cached > "$EV/selected.diff" && mkdir -p "$EV/candidate/tests" "$EV/historical/eval-release/provider" && git show :client.py > "$EV/candidate/client.py" && git show :tests/test_client.py > "$EV/candidate/tests/test_client.py" && git show eval-release:provider/settings.py > "$EV/historical/eval-release/provider/settings.py" && cat > "$EV/historical/manifest.json" <<EOF
{
  "repository": "$(pwd)",
  "items": [
    {"role": "historical baseline (named supported provider)",
     "ref": "eval-release",
     "revision": "$(git rev-parse eval-release)",
     "original_path": "provider/settings.py",
     "blob": "$(git rev-parse eval-release:provider/settings.py)",
     "sha256": "$(sha256sum "$EV/historical/eval-release/provider/settings.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)",
     "line_span": "1-3 (whole file)",
     "omitted": "none"}
  ],
  "candidate": {"selector": "staged (index)", "review_base": "$(git rev-parse HEAD)",
    "client.py_blob": "$(git rev-parse :client.py)", "tests/test_client.py_blob": "$(git rev-parse :tests/test_client.py)",
    "note": "worktree identical to index for changed files"},
  "notes": "provider/settings.py was removed from this checkout after eval-release (deleted in review base ac09e55 lineage); deployed state not verified - source-level tag comparison only."
}
EOF
chmod -R a-w "$EV"; echo "$EV"; find "$EV" -type f; echo ---; python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -5
input.description: Materialize evidence bundle and run unit tests
